articles.summary: First United Bank & Trust is proud to announce Michael Renzi as the Community Office Manager for the Sabraton Office in Morgantown.
articles.title: Michael Renzi named Community Office Manager in First United Sabraton Office

articles.summary: First United Bank & Trust is pleased to announce that Denise Greenbeck Hess, Deposit Services Relationship Manager, and Marissa Murphy, Information Security and Disaster Recover Officer, recently graduated from the Emerging Leaders Program through the Maryland Bankers Association.
articles.title: First United Bank & Trust’s Denise Greenbeck Hess and Marissa Murphy Graduate from Maryland Bankers Association Emerging Leaders Program
